Package de.abas.ceks.jedp.progress Description

Classes to handle progress messages with JEDP.

If progress messages are activated by setting the session option PROGESS, the edp server periodically sends progress messages (P). These messages are supplied in JEDP by instances of EDPProgressMessageSource using instances of EDPProgressMessage. They can be processed by instances of EDPProgressMessageListeners.

Since:
abas Version 2012r1, EDP Version 3.36
